data.gender_notes: Sabbu is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who rules or masters over a situation or domain, be it material or spiritual. Sabbu is a name of Lord Shiva, the deity of destruction and transformation. The name Sabbu carries the meaning “Ruler, Master, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Sabbu usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, master, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sabbu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, Master, Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabbu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
